claims.statement: Dr. C. E. Tennent alleged that Ben Hogan never meant to fight Tom Allen, and that it was arranged on the train that the ropes be cut and the fight made a draw.

claims.statement: Tom Allen denied fouling Ben Hogan, after Dr. C. E. Tennent had certified that Hogan was struck below the belt.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he sent word to Dr. Tennent that if Tennent told the truth about the fight, Allen would see that he lost nothing.
claims.excerpt: I sent to him to tell him that if/he told the truth abcut the fight

claims.statement: Tom Allen said his Police Court cases over the chase after Hogan had been dismissed on evidence that morning.
claims.excerpt: our cases in the Police Court were all dismissed on evidence
